meta.name: ACC Digital Network
meta.description:
Full-game replays, extended highlights and original programs for ACC Football, Basketball, Volleyball, Soccer, Baseball, Softball and more sports.  24-7 wall-to-wall action for one of the top Conferences across college sports.

Shows: Football Replay, Fast Cast, Football Classic: 2019: Duke at North Carolina, Women's College Soccer, Football Replay: 2020: Pittsburgh at Boston College
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
